With previous girls it was nowhere even close to as difficult as telling this girl about my feelings, and of course I was sweating bullets on the way to the office. I decided to take control of my life and chose to tell her, despite how she may have reacted or how taboo this may seem to society as a whole. I wanted to provide her a gift no matter what her response was, since she was responsible for hiring me/training me and I would feel good no matter what having expressed my gratitude. I therefore decided to go to the office on Sunday to privately tell her/give her the gift. I told her I didn't care what her response was, and that she didn't even owe me one, just that I had to tell her since it caused much strife within me holding it in. I also told her no matter what, I will continue to act professional and serve as an asset to the company. She looked puzzled to say the least, and wasn't ab;e to respond. Believe it or not, I didn't feel awkward, I gave her a gentle smile, said goodbye, and left.

The next day (unsurprisingly) the head honcho boss calls me into her office, and talks with me about the situation. She was very understanding, since I acted professionally and didn't cross any boundaries. Apparently however, my supervisor was extremely upset when I told her about my feelings, and she is unable to look me in the eye anymore. Being that she's 29, I thought she would have been mature enough to handle this in a more professional manner. The boss explained that my supervisor was unable to accept my gift(a thermos, NO chocolates, roses, etc.) since she was reviewing my work. The boss said to wait until things cool down, that even though she is older than me, she is still a "gal" and is emotional (huh...???) We do not speak in person anymore, only by IMing business related things to one another even though her desk is literally less than 10 feet away from me. I've been assigned to my other supervisor (I don't mind this at all, since I really like her as a supervisor) I literally dread seeing her in the corner of my eye now since I believe she thinks she feels unsafe around me. I don't even go to team lunches anymore to spare us both the uneasiness, and whenever she does approach the team lunches I immediately say "I better go finish this report or something" and leave since I don't want to ruin anything for either of us.

I regret my decision, but I can actually sleep at night now that I told her. I am curious though, why would she be upset?
